description: Public copies replace machine-specific absolute path prefixes with safe placeholders. Dataset measurements, assertions, outcomes and test identities are unchanged. Binary files and binary tar-member payloads are preserved byte-for-byte. Archive owner names/IDs and gzip filename/time metadata are removed for publication.
hashInterpretation: Source manifests/indexes record pre-normalization originals. This report maps changed public files and archive members from original SHA256 to published SHA256. Final SHA256SUMS covers the public copies; raw originals are retained outside this audit.

changeRecordMeaning: changes preserves each normalization event at its original path; optional currentFile and relocations resolve a moved public copy without assigning historical hashes to a new candidate. currentPublishedFiles reflects the latest public copies, including later public metadata edits. Final SHA256SUMS remains authoritative.
